name: What are the benefits of converting my garage into a living space?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of converting my garage into a living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting your garage offers several significant benefits. It increases your home's usable square footage and can boost its market value without needing a full home addition. It provides flexible space for a growing family, a dedicated home office, a guest suite, or even rental income if converted into an ADU. This type of conversion is often more cost-effective than building an extension, utilizes existing foundations and structures, and can be completed relatively quickly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits of a garage conversion include increased square footage, enhanced property value, flexible space for various needs, and potential rental income through an ADU.
